notes: Upstream baseline for the WebGPU renderer-backend replacement. The package is installed unmodified from the public registry (pinned exact version + integrity hash above, recorded in package-lock.json); no file under node_modules/@cesium/engine is ever edited by this repository. Only Source/Renderer/** modules listed in packages/cesium-webgpu/backend-webgpu/manifest.json are replaced at build time by the alias plugin (tools/rollup-plugin-engine-patch.mjs), so the logic layer (Scene / Globe / QuadtreePrimitive scheduling / Camera / layers / DrawCommand) stays byte-identical by dependency integrity. A version change MUST trigger tools/upgrade-drill.mjs and a re-evaluation of the MVP estimate (FR-028/FR-032).

glslang.notes: Official prebuilt release archive glslang-16.6.0-linux-x86_64-release.zip; one-shot conversion drafts and CI shader validation only, never a runtime dependency.

naga-cli.notes: No prebuilt binary exists (wgpu release assets empty; naga-cli / @webgpu/naga are not on npm). Version MUST be pinned explicitly with --version and dependents with --locked; CI caches ~/.cargo.

@webgpu/glslang.notes: If used at all, MUST import dist/web-devel-onefile explicitly: the default Node entry was measured hanging for >120 s.

sourceSnapshot.notes: Aggregate sha256 over `Source/**` (one line per module: POSIX relative path, NUL, per-file sha256). Verified by tools/scripts/verify-upstream-integrity.mjs; a single changed byte anywhere under Source/** fails the check. Recorded from the unmodified registry install of the pinned release.
